### Trust and Obey
Author: Kevin Struyk
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/trust-and-obey
Passage: Matthew 7:28-29
Points:
- Jesus astonished listeners because His teaching carried direct divine authority from the Father, unlike the powerless traditions of the scribes.
- Christ demonstrated His ultimate authority through His sinless life, sacrificial death, and resurrection.
- Spiritual power to change hearts comes solely from God's living Word rather than human opinions or techniques.
- Following King Jesus means submitting to His authority and faithfully obeying His commands daily.
- Christian discipleship is expressed through humble service to others rather than worldly rank or status.
